title: Production of Chemicals by Klebsiella pneumoniae Using Bamboo Hydrolysate as Feedstock
protocol: Add 5 g of bamboo powder to 40 mL of an NaOH solution in a 250 mL flask.
Use NaOH solutions ranging from 0.05 M to 0.50 M in increments of 0.05 M.
Incubate the mixture for 60 min at 60 °C or 100 °C in a water bath.
Incubate the mixture at 121 °C in an autoclave.
Leave the mixture to stand for 4 h at room temperature after incubation.
Remove the supernatant from the mixture.
Add 100 mL of fresh water and mix thoroughly.
Repeat washing with fresh water until the pH of the supernatant reaches 6.8.
Adjust 50 mL of the above mixture to a pH of 5.0 using 98% H2SO4.
Add 0.5 mL of 200 filter paper activity (FPU)/mL cellulase.
Incubate the mixture at 50 °C for 36 h in a shaker.
Centrifuge the mixture at 7,690 x g for 5 min to obtain a clear hydrolysate.
Quantify glucose and xylose using an HPX-87H column with a mobile phase of 5 mM H2SO4 solution at 0.8 mL/min flow rate.
Mix 2 kg of bamboo powder and 18 L of 0.25 M NaOH in a 30-L stainless-steel tank.
Incubate the tank at 121 °C in an autoclave for 60 min.
Wash the mixture with 40 L of water in a 60 L plastic tank.
Repeat washing 5 times.
Adjust the total washed bamboo to a volume of 20 L using water.
Adjust the pH of the mixture to 5.0 using 98% H2SO4.
Enzymatically hydrolyze the mixture at 50 °C for 36 h in a modified shaking water bath with mechanical agitation.
Add 200 mL of 200 FPU/mL cellulase before enzymatic hydrolysis.
Centrifuge the mixture at 4,700 x g for 10 min after hydrolysis.
Use 3 L of bamboo hydrolysate as the solvent for medium preparation.
Prepare a fermentation medium containing specific ingredients and adjust pH to neutral with 2.5 M NaOH.
Incubate a 250 mL flask containing 50 mL of LB medium overnight at 37 °C, with shaking at 200 rpm for seed culture.
Use K. pneumoniae cells stored in a -80 °C low-temperature refrigerator for fermentation.
Ferment using a 5-L bioreactor containing 3 L of autoclaved fermentation medium.
Inoculate one flask of 50 mL seed culture into the bioreactor.
Maintain the culture at pH 6.0 and 37°C.
Use an air supplementation rate of 2 L/min.
Set the agitation rate to 250 rpm.
Collect 5 mL samples every 2 hours during fermentation.
Analyze samples using high-pressure liquid chromatography.
Monitor alkali added to the bioreactor online using MFCS/DA.
Prepare a medium for acetoin production with specified components.
Use K. pneumoniae-ΔbudC strain for R-acetoin production.
Maintain the culture at pH 6.0 and 37°C.
Set an air supplementation rate of 4 L/min.
Agitate the culture at 450 rpm.
Assay samples as in step 2.6.
Use K. pneumoniae-ΔbudA for 2-ketogluconic acid production.
Maintain the culture at pH 7.0 and 37 °C during the first stage of fermentation.
Inoculate the seed culture in the bioreactor for the first stage of fermentation.
Maintain an air supplementation rate of 4 L/min during the first stage of fermentation.
Maintain an agitation rate of 500 rpm during the first stage of fermentation.
Allow cell density to reach OD 7 within about 4 hours during the first stage of fermentation.
Progress to the second stage of fermentation when pH decreases to 5.0 naturally due to acid production.
No acid is added during the second stage; organic acids in the culture lead to pH decrease.
Cell growth stops but 2-ketogluconic acid synthesis and accumulation continue in acidic conditions.
Assay samples as described in step 2.6 for analysis.
Use hydrolysate of bamboo as the carbon source for fermentation.
Glucose in the medium is converted to 2-ketogluconic acid during fermentation.
Xylose in the medium is converted to xylonic acid during fermentation.
Obtain a mixture of 2-ketogluconic acid and xylonic acid from the broth.
